Open the HFG Model tab and choose Open probe.
Opens the probe task pane.
Writes a timestamp next to the selected cell without opening the task pane.
The probe enables and disables this button to test ribbon updates.
Tests a menu on the ribbon.
HFG commands for the selected cell.
Build a new model from the HFG template: choose a recipe or modules, the entity, start month and term, preview, then build.
Bring an existing Modano-style workbook, such as the budget template or BUD25, under management by reading its frame, names and checks.
The model in one pane: sections, sheets and modules coloured by area, and for the module selected its rows, its links in and out, its settings and checks.
Every error, alert and sensitivity check in the model, which ones are failing, and a go-to for each failing cell.
Model properties: id, recipe, entity, GST status, version, owner and change history.
The group as a tree with who owns what, each group's figures rolled up, and planned entities added or changed with their share held.
Org tree of the entities with share held, owned by the top and outside investors, the groups each rolls into, and each group's figures rolled up.
Add a planned entity (a future LP or fund) under its parent with its share held, start date and capital; it stays flagged until Home Hub has it.
Change an entity's share held or parent from a date; groups, eliminations and NCI follow from that date and earlier years keep the old structure.
Take out a planned entity, or end an entity that is sold or wound up from a date; its figures stay in the years it belonged.
Pull the entity register and ownership from Home Hub; differences show before anything changes, and planned entities stay until Home Hub has them.
Insert a module from the library. Filter by model type, variant, GST treatment, timeline and version; preview its rows and links first.
Swap a module for another variant, for example revenue from amounts to price times volume. Inputs carry across by key and links are kept.
Copy a module with its own names and links.
Add a module that repeats for every sender of a link, for example debtors for every revenue line.
Rename a module; its names, labels and contents entry follow.
Remove a module, its rows, names, links and checks, after a warning about anything that depends on it.
The Explorer on its Links tab: what the module takes from and sends to, inputs still waiting for a sender, and link or unlink.
Add a category (a site, a revenue line, a facility) at the end of the block; totals, summaries and checks extend.
Add a category above the selected one.
Add several categories at once from a pasted list.
Remove a category; totals and summaries close up.
Group categories under a subtotal inside the block.
Pull actuals from Home Hub by group account and month, mapped and checked.
Send results to Home Hub Planning: to plan lines this model is the source for, or as a proposed scenario.
Import assumptions from a file or another sheet in the hh_in shape.
Map ledger accounts to model lines.
Extend or shorten the timeline, with a preview of every sheet, column, name and check it touches.
Month-end roll forward: pull actuals, move the last actual month and keep inputs on their dates.
Model start, term, financial year end, last actual month, first budget month and denomination.
Pick the active scenario, compare scenarios side by side and run every scenario at once.
Flex chosen inputs by a step, a percentage or a low-high range and record the outputs, with a tornado.
Run the Monte Carlo: trials, seed and sampling; time the run; inspect any trial.
Store scenario or simulation results with their settings and an input fingerprint, so a stale result shows.
Save the budget or this month's reforecast as a version, approve and lock budgets, and compare the reports against any saved version.
Save the statements as values: this month's reforecast (as at the last actual month) or the budget being built.
Make a saved budget the approved budget for its year; the previous one becomes Superseded.
Locked versions cannot be replaced or deleted.
Open the Version comparison: month, year to date and full year against two saved versions.
Rename, delete or push saved versions, and check their checksums.
What a change or a transaction does to the income statement, balance sheet and cash flow, in this model's own lines.
Change one input, see every statement line that moves, the ties and why; the model is put back as it was.
Add an Impacts section: one formula sheet per kind of transaction this model holds, in its own accounts and entities.
Browse the module library: model types, modules, versions and what changed.
Your defaults and this model's settings: contents, links, number formats, names, timeline, checks, page setup, styles.
Show or hide the HFG Build tab with the builder commands.
Help for the command or view in front of you.
Link the selected row to a sender.
Send the selected row as a link item.
Precedents and dependents with labels and values; click to go and back to start.
The Impacts pane for the input under the cursor: what changing it does to the statements.
Add an error, alert or sensitivity check on the selected row; it rolls up to Checks.
Mark cells as work in progress; finalise is blocked until they are cleared.
Sum, average, minimum, maximum and count of the selection.
